content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Gilbert

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's formal eligibility criteria now to confirm you meet the education and hours threshold before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Our instructor-led course delivers all required contact hours through interactive online sessions you can attend from Gilbert. Curriculum covers PMBOK principles, exam domains, and practical application relevant to project managers across education, healthcare, defense, professional services, and manufacturing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at application submission. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process and required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and review sessions, to reinforce bootcamp concepts. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult topics before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or volunteering in project-management activities. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting proof of PDU completion to PMI.
